prompt: A monumental three-story restaurant building fused with a massive tree, standing alone in the vast golden desert, surrounded by empty sand dunes in every direction. The structure appears as a surreal oasis part modern architecture, part living tree. The bark-like textured facade wraps around glass walls and terraces, while enormous twisting roots anchor the building into the sand. Above, a lush green canopy of real plants creates wide natural shade, forming a living roof. Vines, moss, and flowers cascade down the facade. The fusion of tree and structure feels organic, as if the tree has grown through the building, creating a new wonder of the world. Tiny human figures and camels near the base emphasize the scale.
